blind.description: A square wooden shaft collar or pit entrance constructed from thick, dark-stained timber beams stacked two high, reinforced at each of the four corners with squarish corner caps with lighter wood highlights. Inside, the pit is lined with vertical wooden planking descending into darkness. Attached to one interior wall is a two-rung wooden ladder extending just above the rim. A braided tan rope loops over the opposite upper rim and hangs down into the shaft. Geometry is solid, clean, and hand-painted/stylized.
blind.from_above: A square timber frame surrounding a dark square opening, featuring the two stiles of a ladder mounted to the top edge and a looped rope hanging over the right edge.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: none (the shaft interior fades into darkness to depict depth)
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around shin to knee height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 4.5 feet wide by 4.5 feet deep.
